name: @loams-plugins/core
//: The `exports` map is what makes `@loams-plugins/core/ui` resolve. Without it the subpath is unreachable under `moduleResolution: bundler`, and dashboard-ui's `import { CoreShell } from "@loams-plugins/core/ui"` has no entry to land on. `main`/`types` stay for tools that predate `exports`.
